scope: First-step integration plan for EPİAŞ DAM price-independent buy/sell (FİBA/FİBS) and natural gas DRP/GRF into master pipeline.

current_repo_state.epias_auth_pattern: CAS TGT via https://giris.epias.com.tr/cas/v1/tickets, then POST to service endpoints (see update_dataset.py, fetch_*.py).

datasets.name: GÖP Fiyattan Bağımsız Alış Teklifi (FİBA)
datasets.endpoint_status: Unknown (UI URL provided). Requires manual browser Network inspection to discover underlying API path and JSON payload contract.

leakage_risk.reason: Price-independent orders are part of DAM order book; they are known before clearing for the delivery hour (typically D-1). Treat as planned/same-hour observable at anchor.

manual_gaps: Discover API endpoint behind UI page.
Confirm whether response is hourly by delivery hour and which fields map to MWh volumes.
Confirm timezone semantics (Europe/Istanbul) for join onto ts_hour.

datasets.endpoint_status: Unknown (UI URL provided). Requires manual browser Network inspection to discover underlying API path and JSON payload contract.

leakage_risk.reason: Same as buy side: order book volumes are known before clearing for delivery hour (typically D-1).

manual_gaps: Discover API endpoint behind UI page.
Confirm whether response is hourly by delivery hour and which fields map to MWh volumes.

datasets.name: GRF / Günlük Referans Fiyatı (DRP)
datasets.endpoint_status: Unknown (UI URL provided). Requires manual browser Network inspection to discover underlying API path. May use a different service family than electricity-service.

planned_master_merge.granularity_strategy: Daily values expanded to 24 hourly rows for the delivery date to fit master ts_hour.

leakage_risk.reason: Daily publication time is unclear; to avoid same-day leakage, model features should use lag/rolling versions only.

feature_definitions.grf_tl_rolling_mean_7d: rolling mean over past 7 days on grf_tl_lag_1d.

manual_gaps: Discover the natural gas DRP API endpoint and whether CAS auth is required.
Confirm field names/units mapping to the four target columns.
Decide whether daily->hourly expansion should occur in fetch script or cleaning stage.

implementation_sequence_plan: 1) Endpoint discovery (browser Network) for each UI URL; document full URL, method, required headers, payload schema, and response keys.
2) Add three fetch scripts (buy, sell, grf) reusing CAS TGT pattern; write raw CSVs under data/.
3) Extend cleaning pipeline: add hourly CSV sources for buy/sell; add daily-to-hourly handling for GRF.
4) Extend master/schema.py JOIN_DATASETS with DatasetSpec entries (dam_, grf_ prefixes).
5) Add feature engineering in features/engineering.py for fiba/fibs and GRF lag/pressure features with explicit leakage-safe shifts.
6) Add new engineered features to MAIN_REGRESSION_FEATURES / LOW_PRICE_CLASSIFIER_FEATURES as listed above.
7) Validate with master report + feature inventory audit (no training).
